_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.1-21 to 23: fan-favorite chains (plan section 6). Read by tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_chains.py,
which writes src/data/hoenn_fan_chains.h (the table src/hoenn_fan_chains.c reads; its header explains the
weekend rule) and data/scripts/hoenn_fan_chains.inc (the pool texts, word-wrapped like the hint lines).
chains: in HOENN_CHAIN_* order (id names the constant). leader: the key of the leader's entry in
leader_weekends.json; the chain only runs on that leader's weekends (beaten, cameo met), and that
entry's `chain` names the script the weekend spot calls first. stage_var / weekend_var: the chain's
two vars (constants/hoenn_events_2_1.h). steps: four places, one per step: spot (the leader's
weekend spot) or the hide flag of a chain object of its own (placed by hand in that map's map.json).
While a step is ready the leader waits at its place; after it, they stay there for the rest of
that weekend; before the first and after the last they're at the weekend spot.
pool: lines the leader says once the chain is done, taking turns among those whose conditions hold
('if': the hint engine's conditions, data/hoenn/npc_hints.json's comment; all must hold). At most 32.
Write them in the character's voice, about what the player has done; keep a few with no condition.

pool.text: My brothers and sisters each have a favorite fossil in this MUSEUM. There are ten of them. That's a lot of favorites.
A good BREEDER watches before acting. So does a good friend. So does a good GYM LEADER, come to think of it.

text: Keep your POKéMON's bedding dry and their food warm.
ROCK types too. Especially ROCK types.

pool.text: ROCK POKéMON can go a week without eating, you know. I still cook for mine every day. It's the principle.
Your ONIX looks great! See how its rocks shine? Somebody's been polishing it. I can always tell.
A GEODUDE following you! Rub it with a damp cloth now and then. It won't say so, but it likes that.
You have a STEELIX! It started out as an ONIX, like my first partner. I wonder what it remembers.
You found a LILEEP in HOENN? Those fossils come from the sea floor. A plant that crawled out of the ocean!
ANORITH! Its claws are built for the sea, but it walks on land like it was born there. Tough little thing.
Your AERODACTYL flew when the skies were empty. Mine still screeches at PIDGEY out of old habit.
OMANYTE's shell spirals the same way every single time. Nature is very tidy, if you look closely.
A RELICANTH! A living fossil. It hasn't changed in a hundred million years, and it doesn't need to.
ROXANNE in RUSTBORO writes to this MUSEUM about fossils. Her letters have footnotes. I respect that.
You beat WALLACE? All that grace on the outside, and solid as granite underneath. I'd like to try him myself.
You beat RED? He came through PEWTER once. He didn't say a word, just nodded at the fossils.
Sixteen BADGES! When I started out, I thought eight was the whole world.
There's a trainer in HOENN named BROCK? An ATHLETE? Tell him the name comes with responsibilities.
That other BROCK calls you his best friend? I'm not jealous. ROCKS don't get jealous.
Eight BADGES in HOENN, too? Your POKéMON must eat well. That's half the work, you know.
The show's over, but I still swim the SEAFOAM current every weekend. It's my thinking time.
My sisters think the show was all about them. I let them think it. That's what sisters are for.
PSYDUCK fell in the pool during the bows. The crowd thought it was planned. It was NOT planned.

text: Water POKéMON aren't just pretty, you know.

pool.text: Your STARMIE's core is so bright! Somebody's been swimming it in clean water. Good.
A PSYDUCK! Does yours get headaches too? Mine gets one every time I raise my voice. So, often.
Your GOLDUCK swims like an arrow. Mine still floats on its back when it thinks nobody's looking.
Your LAPRAS is humming! They sing when they're happy. Don't tell anyone, but I sang along once.
You have a GYARADOS! I used to be scared of them. Now I just think they're misunderstood.
You raised a MILOTIC? I'd love to see it swim. They say it calms any storm it passes.
KINGDRA! CLAIR has one too. Don't tell her I said hers looks grumpy.
You caught the POKéMON that made the oceans? I'm a little jealous. Okay, a lot jealous.
ARTICUNO roosts deep in SEAFOAM. I've heard it sing over the water, but I've never seen it up close.
You beat JUAN in SOOTOPOLIS? I hear his gym floor is made of ice. Mine's a pool. Mine's better.
WALLACE won a contest with a water show once. I watched the tape a hundred times. For research!
BROCK told me about your trip to MT. MOON. He wouldn't stop talking about CLEFAIRY eggs. For an hour.
You beat RED? He swam to the SEAFOAM ISLANDS once. In jeans. I still don't know how.
Sixteen BADGES? You've seen more gyms than I have pools. Well, almost.
